_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd truck-simulator/american-truck-simulator/egg-american-truck-simulator-dedicated-server.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence), built like euro-truck-simulator-2.json. Octail stops the server with Ctrl+C instead of a kill (^^C), adds an automatic query port instead of the fixed 27016, a lobby name without quotes (it is written into server_config.sii), both start lines the engine prints, the american-truck-simulator tags, the no_console_input flag, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. **Install script fixed**: anonymous login only (the dedicated server needs no account), config files from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned games-steamcmd commit 8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8 instead of the old parkervcp/eggs master paths, failed downloads fail the install, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: American Truck Simulator Dedicated Server
author: chase@cstmgames.com
description: Experience legendary American trucks and deliver various cargoes across sunny California, sandy Nevada and the Grand Canyon State of Arizona. SCS Software's Linux dedicated server for Convoy multiplayer.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# American Truck Simulator dedicated server (pelican-eggs, changed for Octail: anonymous SteamCMD retried up to 3
# times, config files from the pinned games-steamcmd commit, failed downloads and a missing server fail the install)
set -uo pipefail

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || exit 1
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/bin/linux_x64/amtrucks_server" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the American Truck Simulator dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.local/share/"American Truck Simulator"/
cd /mnt/server/.local/share/"American Truck Simulator"/

if [ ! -f server_config.sii ]; then
    echo "a config file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_config.sii https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/server_config.sii || exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f server_packages.sii ]; then
    echo "a server_packages.sii file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_packages.sii https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/american-truck-simulator/ats-files/server_packages.sii || exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f server_packages.dat ]; then
    echo "a server_packages.dat file does not yet exist making one!"
    curl -fsSL -o server_packages.dat https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/truck-simulator/american-truck-simulator/ats-files/server_packages.dat || exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, written to server_config.sii. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Steam Auth token
variables.description: Without a token the server gets a new search id at every start. Create one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with app id 270880 (the game, not the server's 2239530).

variables.name: Lobby name
variables.description: The server name in the convoy browser (no double quotes or backslashes).
